metadata.name: manifest-sources
metadata.description: Family for adapters that render a source location (git+kustomize, git+helm, ...) into raw Kubernetes objects. Rendered objects are forwarded to a target integration (usually kubernetes) for apply.

spec.description: Contract for any provider that turns a source location into a rendered Kubernetes object set. Providers (kustomize, helm, jsonnet, kpt) implement subsets of these operations via IntegrationType.implemented_operations.

operations.name: generate_installation
operations.description: Render the source into Kubernetes objects.

operations.name: reconcile_installation
operations.description: Same rendering, framed as a reconcile plan for apply.

operations.name: discover_installation_state
operations.description: Return static planned state (manifest-sources are not stateful).
